name: pico cam
summary: iPhone camera app that turns moments into tiny instant-style photos with Dynamic Island reveals.
description: A playful iPhone camera that makes tiny instant-style photos, with Dynamic Island and Live Activity reveals, filters, frames, drawing and an on-device gallery. It works on iPhones with and without a Dynamic Island, supports iPhone 11 through iPhone 17 Pro Max including SE on iOS 18 or later, and photos stay on the device.
contains: tiny instant-style photos with Dynamic Island and Live Activity reveals
filters, frames and drawing on photos
on-device gallery; photos are not uploaded
supports iPhone 11 through iPhone 17 Pro Max incl. SE, iOS 18 or later
free download with optional pico cam+ purchases
